We are supporting a global leader in digital engineering and enterprise modernisation to appoint a Lead Quality Engineer & Project Lead – Quality for their Melbourne team. We are seeking an experienced performance testing professional to take ownership of performance engineering strategy and delivery across complex enterprise projects. This role combines deep technical hands-on expertise with leadership responsibility, working directly with clients and internal centres of excellence to deliver measurable quality outcomes.
This position plays a critical role in defining and implementing performance test strategies, leveraging industry-leading tools and AI-driven approaches to ensure enterprise applications meet the highest standards of performance, scalability, and reliability.
Your key responsibilities:
•	Define and implement performance test processes, strategies, and approaches for complex test requirements, securing buy-in from stakeholders across the business

•	Lead performance test design and automation activities, including AI-led performance test automation, results analysis, issue identification, reporting, and overall project delivery
•	Work directly with clients and internal centres of excellence to ensure alignment on quality objectives and delivery outcomes
•	Design and implement testing strategies leveraging leading performance testing tools across UI, API, and data layers

Your role requirements:

Type: Full-time
Employer: Melbourne Truss
Location: Somerton VIC
Salary: $90,000 per annum
About the Business:
Melbourne Truss, established in 2005 and based in Somerton, Victoria, is one of the leading manufacturers of prefabricated timber roof trusses, wall frames, floor trusses and posi struts in Melbourne. As a licensed Pryda fabricator, the company utilises the latest design and processing technologies to produce high-quality, certified products tailored to the exact requirements of commercial, residential and owner-builder projects. Trusted by reputable builders across the region, Melbourne Truss also offers transportation services, timber sales and a wide range of lock-up and fixing items. The business prides itself on reliability, efficient material use and a dedicated team committed to delivering superior building frames and exceptional customer service.
About the Position:
The Supply and Distribution Manager plays a pivotal role at Melbourne Truss by overseeing the procurement, storage, inventory management and distribution of materials and finished products in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This position ensures seamless logistics for timber supplies and prefabricated components, coordinating timely deliveries to construction sites while optimising costs and maintaining stock levels. Critical to operational efficiency, the role supports the company's commitment to reliable output and customer satisfaction in the building industry.
Key Responsibilities:
Determine, implement and monitor purchasing, storage and distribution strategies, policies and plans.
Negotiate contracts with suppliers to meet quality, cost and delivery requirements.
Manage inventory systems to maintain optimal stock levels at minimum cost, including tracking movements of raw materials and finished goods.
Oversee transportation and delivery logistics to ensure timely and efficient distribution to customers.
Liaise with production, sales and external stakeholders regarding supply requirements and outbound goods.
Monitor and review storage facilities and inventory controls to comply with safety and operational standards.
Identify opportunities for process improvements to enhance supply chain efficiency and reduce costs.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Bachelor degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in supply and distribution management, preferably in a manufacturing or construction-related industry.
Proven skills in inventory management, procurement negotiation and logistics coordination.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with proficiency in inventory software and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent leadership, communication and interpersonal skills to manage teams and collaborate with stakeholders.
Ability to work in a dynamic environment with a focus on safety, efficiency and continuous improvement.

result.description:
A Building Associate supervises construction sites and organises and coordinates the material and human resources required for a project.

Role Overview
Phoeniks is seeking an experienced Building Associate to supervise and coordinate the construction-related aspects of its ventilated ceiling installation projects nationally. The role sits within Phoeniks' technical and construction supervision function, assisting Construction Managers, Architects and Engineers in the planning, feasibility assessment, and on-site delivery of ventilated ceiling works across commercial, healthcare and institutional projects.

The successful candidate will act as Phoeniks' supervising construction sites, coordinating labour and materials, interpreting plans and codes, and ensuring works are feasible, compliant, and delivered to specification.

Key Responsibilities
1. Assisting Construction Managers, Architects and Surveyors in Planning and Organisation
- Support Construction Managers, Architects and Engineers in planning and organising ventilated ceiling works, including sequencing, access and integration with the broader head-contractor construction program
- Provide technical input during project planning, value engineering and problem-solving stages, working closely with the Product Manager and Technical Manager

2. Interpreting Plans, Regulations and Codes of Practice
- Read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, specifications and construction documentation for ventilated ceiling installations
- Interpret and apply Australian Standards, building codes, and WHS regulations relevant to ceiling and building services works

3. Preparing Preliminary Sketches, Working Drawings and Specifications
- Prepare preliminary installation sketches and site-specific working drawings for ventilated ceiling systems
- Develop method statements and installation specifications tailored to individual site conditions

4. Preparing, Editing and Revising Plans, Maps, Charts and Drawings
- Edit and revise installation drawings, ceiling layout plans and services coordination charts in response to site conditions, clashes or design changes
- Liaise with the Product Manager – Ventilated Ceilings on drawing updates arising from product-specific requirements or site variations

5. Coordinating Works Programs
- Coordinate ventilated ceiling installation programs and sequencing across multiple sites nationally, aligning with the head contractor's overall construction program
- Supervise and support installation teams and subcontractors to ensure correct methods, sequencing and workmanship
- Assist with commissioning and handover activities as required

6. Inspecting Work and Materials for Compliance with Specifications, Regulations and Standards
- Attend project sites to inspect in-progress and completed works, ceiling structures, and materials for compliance with drawings, specifications and Australian Standards
- Conduct quality checks, identify defects, risks or required rework, and provide clear technical feedback to internal teams
- Ensure all site activities comply with WHS regulations, site safety plans and Phoeniks procedures

7. Calculating Costs and Estimating Time Scales
- Estimate installation time scales, labour requirements and material costs for ventilated ceiling projects, feeding into project programs and budgets
- Assess the technical feasibility of proposed installations prior to project confirmation, identifying risks, constraints and cost implications for internal teams

8. Collecting Data Using Surveying Instruments and Photogrammetric Equipment
- Collect on-site measurement and survey data — levels, dimensions, structural grid and services coordination data — using appropriate surveying and measuring instruments
- Record site conditions using photographic and measurement-based survey methods to support pre- installation feasibility assessments

9. Performing Routine Computations and Plotting Preliminary Data
- Perform routine dimensional, load and quantity computations to support installation drawings and material take-offs
- Plot preliminary layout and survey data to inform installation planning and drawing preparation

Training & Knowledge Transfer
- Train Phoeniks installation teams and subcontractors nationally on ventilated ceiling systems, promoting best-practice installation methods and quality standards across all regions
- Develop and deliver practical, on-site and workshop-based training sessions

Skills & Experience
Essential
- Relevant qualification or at least three years of relevant industry experience
- Proven experience supervising construction sites, ceiling systems, HVAC-related installations, or building services installations
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and construction documentation
- Strong understanding of site conditions, services coordination and construction sequencing
- Ability to collect and interpret site survey/measurement data and perform routine technical computations
- Willingness and ability to travel nationally on a regular basis

result.description:
VeiraMal Consulting is seeking an experienced an Architectural Draftsperson to join our clients' business Kubra Building Services Pty Ltd in Hawthorn East. Our client is looking for an enthusiastic individual who can work well in a team, with strong communication skills.

The successful applicant will be responsible for assisting construction managers, architects and surveyors in the planning and organisation of construction projects. This is a hands-on drafting role suitable for a candidate with practical experience in preparing drawings, interpreting plans and coordinating project documentation.

Key Responsibilities:

- Assist construction managers, architects and surveyors with planning, design coordination and project organisation.
- Interpret architectural plans, building regulations, standards and codes of practice.
- Prepare preliminary sketches, working drawings, specifications and detailed documentation for construction projects.
- Prepare, edit and revise plans, maps, charts and technical drawings using drafting software and relevant tools.
- Review drawings and documentation to ensure accuracy, consistency and compliance with project requirements.
- Coordinate works programs and assist with project documentation and scheduling requirements.
- Collaborate with architects, engineers, builders and other stakeholders to support project delivery.
- Maintain accurate records of drawings, revisions and project documentation.
- Ensure drafting work is completed in accordance with industry standards and workplace procedures.

Requirements:

- Relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design or a related field.
- Relevant experience as an Architectural Draftsperson, Building Designer or similar role.
- Ability to interpret architectural drawings, plans, regulations and construction documentation.
- Experience preparing and revising technical drawings and specifications.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy in drafting work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good understanding of construction processes and documentation requirements.

Salary: $80,000.00 - $90,000.00 per annum plus superannuation

Location: Level 1, Suite 3, 785 Toorak Road, Hawthorn East, VIC 3123

Hours: 38 hours per week

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.
